title: Contemporary Countertop Paper Towel Holder Stand - 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Valet, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels close and your kitchen counter looking clean—backed by a limited lifetime warranty. This freestanding, contemporary paper towel valet is crafted from solid brass with a weighted base for steady, one-handed tearing.

  • Reduce countertop clutter with a compact, easy-to-place stand
  • Stay stable during daily use thanks to a solid brass weighted base
  • Protect stone, wood, and other surfaces with a felt bottom pad
  • Match your space with a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Unlike mass-market alternatives, solid brass construction delivers enduring performance and corrosion-free, rust-free use in the kitchen. Complete your kitchen with matching pieces in the same finish.

Specs
Dimensions: 5 in. L x 14 in. H x 5 in. W
Mounting: Freestanding (no wall mounting)
Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
Included: Paper towel holder
Assembly Required: No
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
